- `on: workflow_dispatch` with inputs: skipTests, deploySnapshot, runIntegrationTests
- One job `build` on ubuntu-latest, timeout 20 minutes

- P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP: Evaluate skipping unused-dependency updates - secondary report only, needs primary dependency-use and history conditions.

- P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY: ci_service scope.
- P-LIT-SELECT: build_configuration scope.
- P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT: ci_service scope.
